notes.text: Refresh the implementation contract against current official Claude Code documentation before development starts. Decision state: proposed.

problem: Instruction Explorer currently models Codex repository instruction discovery only, so repositories using Claude-specific sources cannot inspect that profile deterministically.

risk.rollback: Disable the Claude profile while retaining the Codex profile and the existing AGENTS.md to CLAUDE.md convention lint.

scope: Define a versioned Claude repository profile from current official documentation, including repository-local imports, path-scoped rules, and load-on-demand distinctions that can be derived from one mirrored commit.
Present a conforming CLAUDE.md containing only @AGENTS.md as a bridge when the project policy is enabled, while preserving independent CLAUDE.md content when it is disabled.
Keep user, enterprise, managed, plugin, skill, subagent, memory, and repository-external sources visibly outside the report rather than implying a complete runtime prompt.
title: Add a versioned Claude instruction profile
validation: Fixtures cover enabled and disabled bridge policy, independent CLAUDE.md content, safe local imports, path scope, unresolved external imports, and all configured scan limits.
The rendered profile names its version, documentation source, and as-of date without claiming to reproduce Claude's complete prompt.
value: Teams using Codex and Claude can compare repository-visible instruction behavior from the same immutable project release.
